item.title: Clare Dentists Collected Over €1.3M For Medical Card Treatments Last Year
item.description: Dentists in Clare collected over €1.3m in payments for treatments administered to medical cardholders in 2025. New HSE figures show there was a marginal increase in the number of patients treated in this county last year. Approximately 20,322 treatments were carried out in Clare last year under the Dental Treatment Services Scheme. item.description: Six more Clare players have entered the history books as Fitzgibbon Cup Champions. item.title: Clare Tie In First Game Of 2026 National Camogie League
item.description: Clare have tied in their first game of the 2026 National Camogie League Eugene Foudy’s side were in Abbotstown to take on Dublin in the opening game of Division 1B. Lorna McNamara scored Clare’s goal going into the 2nd half. A full time result of 0-16 Dublin and 1-13 Clare.
